cohort: Women who delivered between 2020 and 2022 and were diagnosed with preeclampsia toxemia (PET), excluding those with incomplete records, multiple gestations, and fetal malformations.
finding: In patients with preeclampsia toxemia (PET), an APRI score > 0.26 was associated with an increased risk for small for gestational age (SGA) newborns and preterm deliveries before 34 weeks.
